description: Fixed-anchor A/B control twin of exp014, IDENTICAL config except lut_layer_type=fast (FastMultiHeadLut, fixed anchor-pair sign tests, no learned hyperplanes). Same small backbone (dim256/4h/6L/ctx512, untied emb), same naps qk4/v6/out6/res6/emb6, shared tph 120, forward hard, backward dense_K. Fewer params than exp014 (no hyperplane w/b). Recipe identical to exp014/exp010. Tests learned-vs-fixed hyperplane front-end at ~70M scale.
